notes: Prism 2.9.0: dictation comes to Windows. Hold a key, speak, and the words land where you were already typing — no window to switch to, nothing to copy across. It is off until you want it: turn it on in Settings and pick the key you hold. Dictation reads the room, too — a code editor gets your identifiers, paths and commands left exactly as spoken, while a quick message does not get a full stop it never needed. Your dictation dictionary follows your account properly now: a name you add on one machine turns up on the other instead of quietly replacing what was already there, and the "sounds like" corrections you type finally reach the model that tidies the text, so a name Prism keeps mishearing can be taught once. Your audio is never stored. Free.
